intro: Fyrdsman (the Viking), tested in the real game with scripted routes against every DI (the nine stick directions an opponent can hold when hit), with and without mashing, and against the level 9 CPU. Every clip is a recording of the game itself; click one to play it.
note: Odds are from 20 headless runs each, because the game has some randomness. Nothing found here is a zero-to-death on Flint whatever direction he drifts.
footer: Recorded 2026-11-12 from the dev build with tools/viking-record.js; clip list in tools/viking-studies/clips-list.js, odds from tools/viking-studies/clipodds.js. Testing tools only; nothing in the game was changed.

clips.route: A+B on; forward smash
facts: KOs at 55% on all nine DIs

clips.title: Kill confirm at 55%: fthrow, recall, back air
clips.route: axe on right platform; grab_f w20 rc w7 fh w9 bair
facts: Forward throw, the axe recalled off the platform, then a back air
Mashing: kills on 5 of 9 DIs (survives neutral, in, down and down-in)
Not mashing: kills on 6 of 9 (survives down, down-in and down-out)

clips.title: 4 hits from 0% (62%): grab, recall, back air
clips.route: axe on right platform; grab_f w20 rc fh w9 bair
facts: The best route from 0% on Flint: 4 hits, 53 to 62%
On DI out, up or up-out the back air misses: 3 hits, 38%
No route tested kills Flint from 0% on every DI

clips.title: Missed-tech punish: Berserker dtilt, recall KOs Potato Sack at 0%
clips.di: any DI, if the Sack misses its tech
clips.route: A+B on; axe stuck far right; dtilt w3 fh rc
facts: The down-tilt knocks the Sack down; the recalled axe hits it on the floor and carries it off the far side
The combo counter resets on the knockdown, so this is not a true combo
Mashing out of hitstun stops the Sack from teching (each shield press restarts the 40-frame tech lockout)
Getting up in place still dies; any tech or roll away survives

clips.title: Same route, the Sack techs the landing: it survives
clips.route: dtilt w3 fh rc
facts: Shield pressed in the 11 frames before landing
Tech in place, tech roll either way and a roll away from the floor all escape, on every DI

clips.title: Kill confirm at 55%? fthrow, platform-axe recall KOs half the time
clips.route: axe on right platform; grab_f w18 rc

A coin flip, not a confirm

clips.title: Recall across the stage KOs Flint at 80%
